arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ. (وَإِنْ قَالَ): اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ.
transliteration: Allahumma a'ithhu min 'athaabil-qabr. (Wa in qaala): Allahummaj'alhu faratan wa salafan, wa ajran liwaalidayh.
translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave. (It is also good to say): O Allah, make him a preceding reward and a stored treasure for his parents, and an answered intercessor for them.
reference: Al-Bukhari. See also Al-Baghawi, Sharh As-Sunnah 5/357

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ.
transliteration: Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawaazeenahumaa, wa a'thim bihi ujoorahumaa, wa alhiqhu bisaalihil-mu'mineen, waj'alhu fee kafaalati Ibraheem, wa qihi birahmatika 'athaabal-jaheem.
translation: O Allah, make him a cause for the scales of their good deeds to be heavy, and magnify their reward because of him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him under the care of Abraham, and protect him by Your mercy from the torment of Hellfire.
